from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from temporalio.client import Client
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/kyc/workflows")

class SanctionOverrideRequest(BaseModel):
    cleared_reason: str
    compliance_token: str

@router.post("/{workflow_id}/signal/override-sanction-flag")
async def signal_sanction_override(
    workflow_id: str,
    payload: SanctionOverrideRequest,
    temporal_client: Client = Depends(get_temporal_client),
    agent: ComplianceAgent = Depends(get_compliance_agent),
    kyc_repo: KYCRepository = Depends(get_kyc_repo)
):
    case = await kyc_repo.find_case_by_workflow(workflow_id)
    if not case:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="KYC case not found")
    if case.assigned_agent_id != agent.id and not agent.is_chief_aml_officer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: agent is not assigned to this KYC onboarding case")

    handle = temporal_client.get_workflow_handle(workflow_id)
    await handle.signal("override_sanctions_check", payload.cleared_reason, agent.id)
    return {"status": "sanctions_override_sent", "workflow_id": workflow_id}
